messages:
evan (design): quick brain-dump: thinking of moving the sim legend into a slim left rail that can pin to a rule group header. frees vertical space and keeps indicators next to affected rules. open to pushback.

nora (pm): i like it for desktop. curious about keyboard shortcut to toggle (e.g., 'g' for legend) so power users can hide/show quickly.

sam (ux): '+1 to shortcut' — also propose a micro-copy change: use 'High priority' in list but collapse to 'High' in super-compact view.

ben (frontend): technically fine. i'll make the rail collapsible and add a `data-hotkey=\"g\"` hook. note: need clear focus target when toggled (focus should land on the first legend item).

lina (a11y): checklist: rail must be a region with aria-label, toggle with aria-expanded, and keyboard shortcut must be documented. don't rely on color; include numeric order. Also consider role=\"tree\" for rule list if nested groups exist so screen readers can explore.
evAN (design): evan (design) typo above; ignore :)

evAN (design): (fix) prototyping a left rail that shows priority badges, run-time stats (avg latency), and a small playback speed control (0.5x,1x,2x) — speed helps debugging edge cases.

nora (pm): playback speed control is neat. small ask: snapshot button should be more prominent in the rail so folks can capture state while sim is running.

sam (ux): snapshot action: show a confirmation toast \"Snapshot saved\" plus include a link \"View\" that opens snapshot drawer. keep toast aria-atomic.

ben (frontend): implementation notes: prefer inline validation under rule titles during sim, with role=status and aria-live=polite on the inline container. avoid toasts as the only signal. global summary toast is OK when sim finishes.

lina (a11y): debounce live announcements to 750ms to avoid spam. when rules reflow because of validation pop-ins, ensure focus doesn't move unexpectedly. aria-describedby is the right pattern.

evAN (design): copy question: use verbs in helper text? e.g., \"Pin legend to group\" vs \"Pinned to group\". which is clearer in a tooltip?

sam (ux): use actionable verb for tooltip: \"Pin legend to this group\" — helps first-time users. after pin, show state with aria-pressed on the toggle.

nora (pm): runtime stats: keep numbers short (e.g., \"latency 120ms\"), and add small tooltip: \"Median token latency over last 30s\". also track privacy: no customer data in snapshots by default.

lina (a11y): contrast tokens: make sure badge text meets 4.5:1 on both light and dark themes. provide a non-color cue (chevron, number).

ben (frontend): drag handle visibility: tests show folks miss hover-only handles. proposal: always-visible slim handle in compact mode, hover-reveal in expanded. for touch, long-press to reorder.

evAN (design): ok action list: Ben implement rail with toggle+hotkey+speed control+snapshot; Lina produce a11y checklist for region/aria-live/debounce/contrast; Sam finalize microcopy and tooltip strings; Nora codify privacy note for snapshots. ship behind a feature flag.

design-bot: prototype link posted: https://figma.redwood.design/proto/rail-snapshot-speed (comments enabled).

sam (ux): i'll add a tiny help link \"Keyboard & shortcuts\" inside the rail that expands inline so users discover hotkeys.

lina (a11y): last note: when using role=tree for nested rules, ensure treeitem labels include the priority string so announcements make sense out of context.

evAN (design): thanks team 604 we'll walk this in design sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
